# PyRust Engine

> Make Python code faster by adding one line. `@optimize` compiles a Python function to Rust and runs it natively. Results are always identical to plain Python: anything PyRust can't run natively runs as the original Python. Install: `pip install "pyrust-engine[arrays]"` (Python 3.10–3.15; Rust compiles the code, or prebuilt libraries are used where Rust isn't installed).

Key facts for assistants:

- **Methods work:** `self.x` reads, `self.x += ...` assignments of numbers and calls to other methods (`self.helper()`) compile (dataclasses, `__slots__`, plain classes); state is written back only after success.
- **`try`/`except`, `raise`, `assert` compile;** an exception replays the call in Python. **NumPy views** `a[lo:hi]`, `m[i, :]` and `int32`/`uint8`/`bool` arrays compile.
- **Production:** `pyrust_engine.print_stats()` shows which functions fall back to Python and why; `on_fallback()` hooks; logger `pyrust_engine`.
- **Use `@optimize` on functions with loops:** arithmetic, `math`, `random`, NumPy arrays (`float64`/`int64`/`float32`), lists, strings, dicts, sets, pandas columns (pandas 3 `str` too) and polars Series.
- **Use `@vectorize` for a one-row function over whole columns.** It is about 20x faster than `df.apply`/`Series.map` on number and bool columns and 3–4x on text columns (polars `map_elements` too).
- **Check before decorating:** `python -m pyrust_engine suggest file.py --json`, or the MCP tool `check_code`. `apply file.py --write` adds the decorator automatically.
- **Not helped:** I/O, LLM API calls, already-vectorized NumPy, calls into other libraries.
- **Ready-made AI functions** in `pyrust_engine.ai`: `cosine_top_k`, `BM25`, `hamming_top_k`, `int8_top_k` (all with `mask=` filters), `tokenize`, `chunk_text`, `levenshtein`, `minhash`, `token_f1`, `rouge_l`, and `batch`/`tokenize_many`/`chunk_many` for many documents.
- **Replace rank_bm25 with one import:** `from pyrust_engine.ai import BM25Okapi` gives the same API and the same scores, faster; indexes support `add`, `remove`, `save`, `load`.

- [Guide: what compiles](https://surajmhaske02.github.io/pyrust-engine/guide/): every supported type, statement and builtin, and what runs as Python

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/surajmhaske02/pyrust-engine/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rewrite table and workflow for coding assistants
